The '''Alderaan Guard''' was the royal and diplomatic protective [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==History==
[[File:Alderaan_guard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alderaanian Guard escort [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
'''Royal Guards''' protected the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] as well as the members of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] and were largely ceremonial in nature. They wore traditional [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and slack hats and were equipped with riot-halting repellant foam and antiquated and ineffectual long [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]] that were usually only fired at royal [[Funeral/Legends|funerals]].

The '''Alderaanian Guard''', or '''Senatorial Guard''', protected Alderaan's delegation to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senates]] and various Alderaanian [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]. The Guard also had a space presence, consisting of [[Alderaanian War Frigate]]s and [[Thranta-class War Cruiser|Alderaanian War Cruisers]].
